scope.purpose: Third-pass search for a dated official publication manifestation of each exact Council document version.
scope.governing_rule: Historical-readiness specification section 5.1: publication_date is the date of the official publication represented by the primary cited source for that exact version; issue, adoption, meeting, retrieval and current-public-status dates are not interchangeable with publication.

common_evidence.locator: Public-register metadata guide, PDF pages 14-15 and 18: the register is updated daily; Publication status is a separate field whose value can vary over time; Issue Date means the date on which the document is issued.
common_evidence.finding: The official guide confirms that a current Public status plus an Issue Date cannot establish when an exact document became publicly available.

common_evidence.locator: Public-register search interface and exact-number searches for 9645/24, 10752/26 and 10599/26.
common_evidence.finding: The register exposed exact versions as currently public and displayed document dates, but no independently dated publication event was available in the returned metadata.

common_evidence.locator: Council public-access request search and exact-number queries.
common_evidence.finding: No dated access-request record tied to any of the six exact manifestations was located.

observed_evidence.locator: Cover identifier and masthead.
observed_evidence.finding: The exact REV 1 manifestation carries the Council issue date 15 May 2024; this is document_issue evidence, not publication evidence.

observed_evidence.locator: Document information: Document ST_9645_2024_REV_1; Date of document 15/05/2024; Author Council of the European Union; Form I/A item note.
observed_evidence.finding: The official mirror confirms identity, issue date and Council authorship, but does not expose a publication-date field.

observed_evidence.locator: A-item list issued 17 May 2024, item citing 9645/1/24 REV 1 + ADD 1 REV 2.
observed_evidence.finding: This later package proves the exact document was scheduled for adoption; it does not state when REV 1 itself was published.

observed_evidence.locator: Draft minutes issued 28 May 2024, AI Act item citing 9645/1/24 REV 1 and recording adoption on 21 May 2024.
observed_evidence.finding: The minutes establish the Council adoption event, not the publication date of REV 1.

corrections: Keep 2024-05-15 only as the exact document issue date; do not relabel it as publication.
Council/General Secretariat cover-note attribution remains distinct from the Council adoption event.
hold_reasons: No newly located official source supplies a dated publication manifestation or historical public-release timestamp for exact ST 9645/1/24 REV 1.
Current Public status, the 15 May issue date, the 17 May A-item package and the 21 May adoption event cannot substitute for publication_date.

observed_evidence.locator: Cover identifier and masthead; statement headings and bodies.
observed_evidence.finding: The exact ADD 1 REV 2 manifestation is issued 15 May 2024. France and Austria are the statement authors; the Council is the host/wrapper, not the substantive author of the national statements.

observed_evidence.locator: Exact Council-document identifier and title; direct open returned the EUR-Lex JavaScript verification page during this review.
observed_evidence.finding: Official mirror identity/current availability was found, but no readable dated publication field was obtained; the challenge was not bypassed.

observed_evidence.locator: A-item list issued 17 May 2024, exact citation 9645/1/24 REV 1 + ADD 1 REV 2 and note that the statements are set out in ADD 1 REV 2.
observed_evidence.finding: This independently corroborates version identity and the France/Austria statement package, not its publication date.

corrections: Attribute the substantive statements to France and Austria; retain the Council only as institutional host/wrapper.
hold_reasons: No newly located official source supplies a dated publication manifestation or historical public-release timestamp for exact ST 9645/24 ADD 1 REV 2.
The exact A-item citation and later adoption record corroborate identity and context only.

observed_evidence.locator: Cover and paragraphs 6-8.
observed_evidence.finding: The exact INIT note is issued 22 June 2026 by the General Secretariat to the Council and recommends adoption subject to legal-linguistic finalisation; the cover date is document_issue only.

observed_evidence.locator: Document information: exact identifier ST_10752_2026_INIT; Date of document 22/06/2026; Author Council of the European Union; procedure 2025/0359/COD.
observed_evidence.finding: The official mirror confirms identity, issue date and procedure, but exposes no publication-date field.

observed_evidence.locator: A-item list for the 29 June 2026 Council meeting, citing 10752/26 + ADD 1 and PE-CONS 30/26.
observed_evidence.finding: The package supports agenda/adoption context only; its date is not a publication date for ST 10752/26 INIT.

observed_evidence.locator: Dated 29 June 2026 release and document links.
observed_evidence.finding: The release establishes final Council approval and links the PE-CONS text; it does not publish or identify ST 10752/26 INIT as the represented primary manifestation.

corrections: Treat the General Secretariat as cover-note sender and the Council as intended adopter; do not infer adoption from the draft recommendation itself.
hold_reasons: No newly located official source supplies a dated publication manifestation or historical public-release timestamp for exact ST 10752/26 INIT.
The 29 June adoption package and press release are adoption evidence for the legislative act, not publication evidence for this Council note.

observed_evidence.locator: Cover identifier and masthead; statement headings and bodies.
observed_evidence.finding: The exact ADD 1 manifestation is issued 22 June 2026. Belgium and the European Commission are the substantive statement authors; the Council is the host/wrapper.

observed_evidence.locator: Document information: exact identifier ST_10752_2026_ADD_1; Date of document 22/06/2026; Author Council of the European Union.
observed_evidence.finding: The official mirror confirms identity/current availability and the document date, but does not supply a publication date.

observed_evidence.locator: A-item list citation 10752/26 + ADD 1.
observed_evidence.finding: The later package corroborates the exact addendum's adoption context, not the date the addendum was published.

corrections: Attribute the statements to Belgium and the European Commission; retain the Council only as institutional host/wrapper.
hold_reasons: No newly located official source supplies a dated publication manifestation or historical public-release timestamp for exact ST 10752/26 ADD 1.
The official mirror's Date of document and the A-item-list date are not publication dates.

observed_evidence.locator: Cover identifier and masthead; statement heading and body.
observed_evidence.finding: The exact ADD 2 manifestation is issued 24 June 2026 and contains Greece's statement; the Council is the host/wrapper rather than the statement author.

observed_evidence.locator: Exact identifier/title was returned by official EUR-Lex results; the English ALL page could not be fetched reliably in this session.
observed_evidence.finding: Exact identity/current availability is corroborated, but no readable official publication-date field was obtained; search-result age labels were not treated as evidence.

observed_evidence.locator: Public vote record dated 29 June 2026.
observed_evidence.finding: This establishes the Council vote/adoption event, not publication of exact ADD 2.

corrections: Attribute the statement to Greece; retain the Council only as institutional host/wrapper.
hold_reasons: No newly located official source supplies a dated publication manifestation or historical public-release timestamp for exact ST 10752/26 ADD 2.
The vote record and 29 June press release establish adoption context only.

observed_evidence.locator: Cover identifier and masthead; note body and annex title P10_TA(2026)0198.
observed_evidence.finding: The exact Council information note is issued 17 June 2026 by the General Secretariat. It transmits the Parliament text adopted 16 June 2026; the annex is Parliament-authored, not Council-authored.

observed_evidence.locator: Exact Council-document mirror; direct fetch returned a cache miss in this session.
observed_evidence.finding: No independently readable publication-date metadata was obtained; no challenge or access control was bypassed.

observed_evidence.locator: Footnote/reference to the Parliament text in ST 10599/26 and recommendation for Council adoption.
observed_evidence.finding: This later Council note confirms lineage and adoption context, but does not date publication of ST 10599/26.

corrections: Treat the General Secretariat as cover-note sender and the European Parliament as author/adopter of the annexed P10_TA(2026)0198 text.
hold_reasons: No newly located official source supplies a dated publication manifestation or historical public-release timestamp for exact ST 10599/26 INIT.
The 17 June cover date, 16 June Parliament adoption and 29 June Council adoption are distinct events and cannot establish publication_date for this information note.

summary.principal_gap: No exact manifestation has a newly evidenced dated official publication event distinct from its issue/adoption/meeting dates.
access_limitations: Council register search exposed current availability and document dates, but not a historical publication timestamp.
Some EUR-Lex exact-document opens returned JavaScript verification or cache/safe-URL errors. These were not bypassed, and search snippets were not used as readiness evidence.
The Council latest-documents feed is dynamic and its item dates repeat document issue dates; it cannot establish historical public release.
No exact-number public-access request record was located for the six manifestations.
